(A) We will ensure that all safety rules are strictly followed, and that any cleanup will be handled efficiently. Please let me know if there are any specific procedures for obtaining approval.

(C) I kindly request your permission to use the school playground on Saturday, December 6th, from 6 p.m. to 8 p.m.

det.korean: 소개+행사 언급 → (B) 장소 물색+학교 최적 → (C) 허가 요청 → (A) 안전·청소 약속+절차 문의
det.analysis:
① (A) — (B) — (C): 허가 전에 약속부터? 부자연
② (B) — (A) — (C): 허가 없이 약속?
③ (C) — (A) — (B): 장소 언급 전에 요청?
④ (B) — (C) — (A) ←정답: 장소 → 요청 → 약속
det.tip: 최적 장소 발견 → 사용 허가 요청 → 안전 약속
